status: frozen before v4 method runs; developmental, not preregistered confirmatory
population: all 201750 ED-to-hospital admissions from v3, no future-order selection
split: reuse patient-split-2026 and sample-2026 hashes; previously inspected developmental test
mapping: unambiguous normalized public NDC, then GSN/name support>=10 purity>=0.98 using exactly sampled train40k
primary_input_policy: admission_proxy: chiefcomplaint and acuity assumed triage-available; home_meds charted by admission but entry time unverifiable
future_verified_labs: same admission, previous 24h, non-null charttime and storetime both <= admission; ambiguity or missing excluded
target_window: prescription starttime in [admission,admission+6h); not order authoring time
unknown_label_policy: keep all admissions and unmapped counts; all-case observed-overlap is coverage-biased historical metric; report mapped-label-only sensitivity and unknown-only counts separately, never clinical negatives
drug_space: top80 classes by train40k frequency; recall denominator retains all observed ATC4 targets
clinical_status: two reviewers available, no ratings; no validated ingredient-level DDI/renal knowledge base
paper_methods: GAMENet/SafeDrug/SafeRx-Agent require verified compatible inputs and resources; no placeholder architectures or copied scores
